== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Astromech Shortage (V) (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 1 slip 31), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published full card image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Astromech Shortage (V)]] (original).

* '''Text source:''' [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. During the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship's immunity to attrition by X for remainder of turn. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a [Maintenance] character or a non-[Theed Palace] senator for remainder of turn.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1001_L6097</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>2_116</code>, title, lore, icons, set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
